spans.s: दृ vt. 6Ā (pp. दृत; pres. द्रियते; desid. दिदरिषति) (This root is seldom used by itself; it is generally found in combination with आ) 1. To worship, to honour, Bt.vi.55; 2. to regard, to have regard for, to care for, भूरि श्रुतं शाश्वतमाद्रियंते M.M.i.

दॄ vt. or vi. 4P, 9P (pp. दीर्ण; pres. दीर्यति, दृणाति; pass. दीर्यते) 1. To burst or break asunder, to split open; 2. to tear, to divide, to rend, to pull to pieces.With वि-, to tear asunder, to split, to divide, न विदीर्ये कठिनाः खलु स्त्रियः K.S.iv.5.
दॄ Caus. (दरयति-ते, दारयति-ते) 1. to tear asunder, to divide by digging; 2. to disperse, to scatter.
